summary: In this fiction excerpt from Book 6, the narrator and Professor Halliday are held captive and plan an escape. The narrator notes that meal trays arrive at fixed times, which could be used to time their escape, and proposes staging a fire with the papers of Halliday's half-finished proof to make the captors open the door. Halliday objects strongly, calling the plan madness, while the narrator argues that the concrete room will not burn and that smoke is the main danger.
one_line: Captive narrator and Professor Halliday plan a timed escape, proposing a staged fire using Halliday's half-finished proof to lure the captors open the door.
key_facts: The meal tray came through at thirty-three seconds past two p.m. according to the narrator's watch.
The narrator suggests the meal timing might be exact enough to use for executing the escape.
Halliday says the captors took her phone, so she cannot check the meal timing herself.
The narrator plans to time the next meal and escape before dark.
Halliday says they should wait for Arthur, calling the plan foolhardy and reckless.
The narrator says that reckless is where she lives and refuses to give Halliday a choice.
The narrator reasons that the captors would rush in to save their assets if the captives were in danger from a fire.
The captors' assets are described as the half-finished proof, Professor Halliday, and the narrator.
The narrator proposes using the papers on the table as fuel for a fire.
Halliday is horrified at the idea of burning her half-finished proof, which she calls her life's work.
The narrator says the proof can be rewritten and that leaving a copy with the captors is undesirable.
Halliday asks how they would ignite anything and what would stop the fire from killing them before rescue arrives.
The narrator says ignition is easy and that the room, surrounded by concrete, will not burn.
The narrator says smoke inhalation will be the only real problem with the fire plan.
The narrator notes that nausea makes food unappealing but tells Halliday to eat and pocket food for later.

entities.name: Halliday
entities.role: Professor, captive who objects to the escape plan and is protective of her half-finished proof

entities.name: Arthur
entities.role: Named by Halliday as the person they should wait for before acting
